about: Release slices (plan-release-slicing): one module is one slice. `npm run build` compiles the slices marked released; `npm run build:full` compiles every slice; HEXMAKER_SLICES / HEXMAKER_SLICES_ON / HEXMAKER_SLICES_OFF (or --slices) pick any set (dev/release/slices.mjs resolveSlices). A slice built off leaves no trace in main.js (npm run check:release). The foundation slice is always built. `docs`: README.md and help.md mark its text (<!-- slice:<id> -->), checked for every such slice. `requires`: slices that must be on whenever this one is (a build with this on and one of them off is an error; check:release turns dependents off with them).
